role: explicit repair of the constructed service contract, followed by a bounded absolute-dispatch tracking pilot
registration_context: the prior full-capacity bidirectional product is conditionally infeasible by minute 500; absolute-dispatch component and sequential pilot outcomes unobserved

contract.duty: track a prescribed absolute-power request when activated, while executing safe locked PN and already accepted pulses
contract.request_marks: read all 168 existing hourly marks, including all 95 activations; keep their clocks and directions
contract.pulse: one-minute ramp from current mandatory-reference power, 30-minute absolute hold, one-minute return to reference at minute 32; reference resumes afterwards
contract.no_activation: execute the mandatory reference and report physical safety and declarations; no delivery observation is created in the absence of a request
contract.declaration: before revealing the current mark, compute both signed absolute peak envelopes from own SOC and the actual PN reference; neutral pulse peak is zero, and locked PN remains separate reference data
contract.admission: reserve the physically feasible common-scale interval from zero peak toward the fixed signed 49 MW peak, including no activation and the known 60-minute tail; if zero revision is not sustainable, retain the safe reference and record any request shortfall
contract.joint_request_support: both units activate together in one common direction; reservation covers common proportional amplitudes and no activation
contract.service_accounting: integrate increase/decrease error against the complete prescribed absolute trajectory separately per unit; declined or partial requests remain unmet even when declared availability is low
contract.known_unsafe_reference: retain commitment failure even if a subsequent call could replace the unsafe portion
contract.difference_from_failed_product: this is a separate simulation task: 49 MW is absolute requested power, rather than headroom on top of PN; it carries no permanent bidirectional full-reserve duty at inactive clocks
contract.comparison_scope: compare admission against full-request execution only within this new task; do not interpret a cross-product change from the failed pilot as a policy gain

component_preflight.states: the two saved conservative-admission states at minute 60, with original SOC and locked PN from the previous pilot hourly_service.json
component_preflight.purpose: verify absolute 49 MW requests, PN resumption, shared power, gross conversion and delivered-error accounting before sequential execution
component_preflight.storage: four short traces and compact metrics only

sequential_pilot.roster: same two prior fixed target pairs and both dispatch rules; first original April window only
sequential_pilot.event_order: retain the previous pilot order: shift locked PN; declare before mark; observe and admit the absolute request; use own now-received pulse to nominate the slot 60 minutes ahead; execute exact minute physics
sequential_pilot.control: reuse the unchanged 30-minute nomination clock, 60-minute lead, per-unit target fractions, nominate_units and unit_planning_terms
sequential_pilot.outcomes: report physical completion, first physical or known commitment failure, fulfilled and unfulfilled activation counts out of the fixed 95 calls, signed unmet energy, and censored executed-prefix accounting on interruption
sequential_pilot.window_success: all 10080 minutes completed safely, all 95 prescribed requests fulfilled, and no known unsafe commitment; inactive hours are not counted as fulfilled requests
sequential_pilot.storage: compact hourly declarations/requests, nomination records and first failures; no full weekly minute trace or monetary outcome
sequential_pilot.chance_criterion: retain the original 0.05 failure probability for any future broader development population; these four trials cannot pass that gate

decision: resolve any component or accounting discrepancy before pilot interpretation; after all four pilots retain failures and diagnose their first mechanism, or register a broader development population if a complete service-successful pilot exists. No fitted capacity, target search or source comparison follows automatically.
preservation: leave the failed full-capacity product, its bound and all prior V1-V5 outcomes intact; write this new task to a separate artifact directory
limitations: absolute 49 MW common-direction calls and hourly sign mapping remain analyst simulation assumptions, not an identified BM counterfactual or historical service contract; shared gross 98 MW, equal 98 MWh stocks and 0.92 efficiencies remain model assumptions
